# v0.1.0 finite admission and conformance

<!-- Generated by scripts/check_release_admission.py from docs/release/v0.1.0.toml. -->

This index tracks the finite release requirements of [#417](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/issues/417). It grants no acceptance and proves no property. Its cells refer to the
[checked specifications](specifications.md); their claim statuses and stated
premises retain their meaning. A complete cell reports reviewed evidence,
not correctness of an external compiler or runtime.

The source inventory starts at `c875a6c7fdb56abf6738be9ad4bd870c45d45f12`. The single wire epoch is
10. Constructor coverage must follow every admitted change.

The dimensions below separate source admission, accepted Core, MidIR,
verified LLVM bytes, Official proof, Fast coverage, native tests, measured
costs and normative vocabulary. The naming row has no executable claim.

## Release rollup

`python3 scripts/check_release_admission.py --require-complete` fails until
every required dimension and issue has its completion evidence. The command
checks the index and its specification references; it does not run a verifier.

Finite carriers and tables provide Category, Functor, NatTrans, Iso, Opposite and a selected Monad. S3 and the closure Monad exercise the public compilation path.

Owners: [#756](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/issues/756), [#199](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/issues/199), [#206](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/issues/206).

| source | partial | Public S3 and two-object category instances pass, and bad sparse composition and forged schemas fail. Concrete Hom calls and dependent composition execute. The same category-indexed fn handles noncommuting S3 and a two-object category. The public closure endofunctor on the chain executes both table projections. The nonidentity closure Monad executes its unit and multiplication. S3 tests the order of naturality, and two distinct Monads share an endofunctor in a second example. Ordinary functions take a Monad or one of its two derived views and static object arguments for unit, extend, bind, compose and lift. Presented affine equations, the ordered coordinates of a smooth standard chart and the defining graphs of its typed morphisms replay in the same declaration inventory. Indexed value declarations resolve to entries owned by their declaring package and module in the returned Core, including unused dependency declarations. Correspondence for the rest of the edition remains open. ## Names-only integer vocabulary

Uppercase public type names and all twelve bounded integer spellings are frozen. Nat, Int, literal defaults and explicit conversion retain their meanings. This row admits no bounded-width executable type.

Owners: [#839](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/issues/839).
